hooks.command: $d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $c = [string]$d.tool_input.command; if ($c -match 'python[0-9.]*\s+.*fill_sheets\.py' -and $c -notmatch '--semana') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"[H1 BLOQUEADO] fill_sheets.py chamado sem --semana. Periodo correto: --semana DD/MM/AAAA"}' }

$d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $c = [string]$d.tool_input.command; if ($c -match 'REPORTEI_TOKEN=[A-Za-z0-9]' -or $c -match '(cat|type|print|echo|curl|--key-file|credentials).*service_account\.json' -or $c -match 'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"\u26a0\ufe0f [H3 BLOQUEADO] Credencial em texto detectada. O script nao deve expor REPORTEI_TOKEN, caminho de service_account.json ou tokens JWT diretamente no comando. Use variaveis de ambiente de settings.local.json."}' }
hooks.statusMessage: H3: verificando credenciais expostas em Bash...

hooks.command: $d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $c = [string]$d.tool_input.command; if ($c -match '1crqoxq8hqaQWsoZby5FlQt50gpUZ29buyeRKkv3M5Og') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"[H4 BLOQUEADO] SHEET_ID antigo detectado. Use o ID correto: 16f9MmlyUr3AfhCxfzjupChZjQDPSxw7rXY5ORjd9yXM"}' }

$d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $c = [string]$d.tool_input.command; if ($c -match 'fill_sheets' -and $c -match 'col_[GHIKNP]') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"[H5 BLOQUEADO] Tentativa de escrever em coluna com formula automatica. Colunas protegidas: G, H, I, K, N, P."}' }

$d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($d -match 'last_7d') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"[HOOK BLOQUEADO] Parametro last_7d proibido no Reportei. Use date_from/date_to com segunda a domingo da semana anterior."}' }
